The `guides/conventional-vs-aerobic-septic-texas.md` guide has a great explainer on when conventional is the right answer, but it would land harder with a side-by-side 20-year cost table.

**What I'd want**

A table in the guide that compares:

| Item | Conventional | Aerobic |
|------|--------------|---------|
| Install | $5k–$12k | $8k–$18k |
| Electricity (20 yrs) | $0 | $4k–$7k |
| Maintenance contract (20 yrs) | $0 | $6k–$10k |
| Air pump replacement (20 yrs) | $0 | $600–$1,200 |
| Pump-outs (20 yrs) | $1.5k–$3k | $1.5k–$3k |
| **Total 20-yr** | **$6.5k–$15k** | **$20k–$39k** |

**Why**

The conventional recommendation reads as a preference. The 20-year cost table makes it read as a math choice. People who care about long-term cost will convert on the table.

**Affected files**

- `guides/conventional-vs-aerobic-septic-texas.md`
